title: 第5章  你简直是个天才第6章  不是善心这叫投资
content_zh:
荒原上。
躲在矮土坡后面的青袍男人，在确定了那个少年这个角度看不见他后，才长叹了一口气，从怀里再次掏出一张诡皮地图，准备多绕一点路去「江北坊市」。
按照既定路线。
他应该是要从这个站点出来后，向东一直前进的。
但...
这片荒原极其平坦，视野一览无余，他觉得作为一个高人，要是当着两人的视线走那么长的一段路，多少显得有点失风范。
作为高人，就应该行了善事之后挥挥衣袖眨眼消失，不留下一丝云彩。
“我真是...”
他忍不住摇了摇头有点被自己幼稚的想法所逗笑，半晌后他嘴角才渐渐弱了下去，眼里闪烁着暴虐和烦躁偏头望向江北陈家37号站点的方向，呢喃着。
“当年为什么没一个人愿意像今天这样，拉我一把呢...”
“那样...或许就不会有今天的江北老魔了。”
...
在确定青袍男人已经远去后，陈凡才快速走到木屋后方的草垛里，从中取出「1级捕兽夹」，以及昨晚中招的那头诡物。
捕兽夹可多次重复使用，弊端是一晚只能起效一次。
这头诡物类猴状，看起来就像一只小巧的猴子。
猴嘴几乎占了脸颊的3分之2，密密麻麻的牙齿看起来极其渗人。
每个诡物体内都拥有一枚诡石。
诡石也是这个世界最重要的货币。
“少爷，这头诡物名为「猴头鬼」，常见低级诡物，等级普遍在1-3级，危害性较小，特点是移动速度极快，诡石位于后脑处。”
“...”

陈凡有些微微诧异的望向瘸猴：“你怎么知道的？”
他的脑海里都没有这段记忆，瘸猴当时在陈家只是一个下人又是怎么知道的。
“在被分配到少爷名下时，我们所有下人都经过三年的培训，其中包括一些私塾课，课上讲了这些不少关于诡物的知识。”
“这样...”
陈凡若有所思望向手里的地图，他脑海里有这段模糊的记忆，实际上也有针对家族核心成员的私塾，不过他前身当时在自暴自弃哪里会去这种地方。
“我想起来了，当时家族里还给了你1枚诡石，让你吸收掉那枚诡石成为修行者？”
“是。”
瘸猴声音弱了下来：“在培训结束后，所有下人都得到了1枚诡石，有几个幸运儿成为了特殊修行者被家主亲自领走了。”
“此后我再没获得过诡石，身体素质和以前没有任何区别。”
“说是修行者，但身上却没有任何修行者的气息。”
陈凡点了点头没再说什么，他也想起来了，原本自己在家族里虽然被针对，还不算太明显，但直到16岁那年他吸收了一枚诡石却没觉醒成任何特殊修行者后，连原本还对他报以希望的家主也彻底放弃了他。
此后地位便一落千丈。
很快——
瘸猴撸起袖子，从怀里掏出一柄小刀，割开诡物尸体并掏出一枚沾满血迹的诡石，在自己麻衣上擦拭干净后才递给陈凡。
至此。
加上「诡火」里的那2枚诡石，他共拥有3枚诡石。
...
“...”
陈凡将椅子从屋内搬出来，坐在诡火旁，思考接下来的赚取诡石大计，他无需去「江北坊市」找建筑师来为他打造建筑，这些基础建筑他自己就可以打造。
content_en:
On the wasteland.
The man in green robe hiding behind the low soil slope, after confirming that the young man could not see him from this angle, sighed deeply and took out another sly map from his arms, preparing to take a longer detour to "Jiangbeifang City".
Follow the established route.
He should be heading east after coming out of this site.
But...
This wasteland was extremely flat, with an unobstructed view. He felt that as an expert, it would be a bit out of style to walk such a long distance in front of the two people's sight.
As an expert, you should perform good deeds and then disappear in the blink of an eye, waving your sleeves, leaving no trace of cloud behind.
"I'm really..."
He couldn't help but shook his head and was a little amused by his childish thoughts. After a while, the corners of his mouth gradually weakened, and his eyes flashed with violence and irritability. He turned his head and looked in the direction of Station No. 37 of the Chen Family in Jiangbei, and murmured.
"Why didn't anyone want to help me like today?"
"In that case... maybe there wouldn't be the old devil Jiangbei today."
...
After confirming that the man in green robe had gone away, Chen Fan quickly walked to the haystack behind the wooden house and took out the "Level 1 Beast Trap" and the strange thing that had been caught last night.
Bear traps can be reused many times, but the disadvantage is that they only work once a night.
This strange creature is monkey-shaped and looks like a small monkey.
The monkey's mouth takes up almost two-thirds of the cheek, and the densely packed teeth look extremely penetrating.
Each treacherous object has a treacherous stone inside it.
Stone is also the most important currency in this world.
"Master, this monster is called "Hericium". It is a common low-level monster. Its level is generally 1-3. It is less harmful. It is characterized by its extremely fast movement speed and the shady stone is located at the back of the head. "
"..."
Chen Fan looked at Lame Monkey in slight surprise: "How do you know? "
He didn't even have this memory in his mind. How did Lame Hou know about it when he was just a servant in the Chen family.
"When being assigned to the young master, all of our servants went through three years of training, including some private lessons where a lot of knowledge about strange things was taught. "
"This way..."
Chen Fan looked thoughtfully at the map in his hand. He had this vague memory in his mind. In fact, there were private schools for the core members of the family. However, his predecessor was so self-destructive at the time that he would go to such a place.
"I remember, the family also gave you a strange stone at that time, so that you could absorb that strange stone and become a practitioner? "
"yes. "
Lame Monkey's voice weakened: "After the training, all the servants received a guile stone, and a few lucky ones became special practitioners and were personally taken away by the head of the family. "
“I haven’t won any rocks since then, and my physical fitness is no different from before. "
“He is said to be a cultivator, but he doesn’t have any aura of a cultivator about him. "
Chen Fan nodded and said nothing more. He also remembered that although he was targeted in the family, it was not too obvious. But when he was 16 years old, he absorbed a strange stone but failed to awaken as a special practitioner. Even the head of the family who originally had hope for him completely gave up on him.
Since then, his status has plummeted.
Soon——
The lame monkey rolled up his sleeves, took out a small knife from his arms, cut open the body of the monster and took out a blood-stained stone. He wiped it clean on his linen clothes and handed it to Chen Fan.
So far.
Including the two rocks in "Strange Fire", he has a total of three rocks.
...
"..."
Chen Fan moved the chair out of the house, sat next to the trick fire, and thought about his next plan to earn trick stones. He did not need to go to "Jiangbeifang City" to find an architect to build a building for him. He could build these basic buildings himself.
